description.value:
Magic is powerful, mysterious, but often the hardest part about it is that it lacks form. Spells, especially powerful ones, often require some form of stability or backbone to act as a conduit, especially over time. The school of enchantment knows this all too well.

It’s the same when it comes to combat. While most mystics will point a wand or staff to bring their magic to bear against a foe, an armiger has found great success in sustaining a magic’s potency by wreathing their armaments in spellcraft.

You gain an additional charge option that can be applied to spells with an instantaneous duration:

  • x2 Total Mana Cost: You imbue this spell or cantrip into a weapon you are holding for the next 1 minute with Concentration. The imbuement is lost should you lose Concentration on it, or another creature takes possession of the weapon.
    The first time this imbued weapon or its ammunition strikes a target each round, the following happens:
    • The weapon’s damage die is two sizes smaller.
    • The stored spell is cast on the target originating from the weapon, even if the spell’s target is “Self.”
    • The spell’s first spell attack automatically hits.

system.requirements: Must have the Wizard Starter Abilities
